observations: Blue hammer mill with a cyclone separator for dust/chaff collection.
Powered by a red single-cylinder, hopper-cooled diesel engine.
The unit is mounted on a black metal skid frame.
A dual-belt drive system connects the engine to the mill, visible in photo 2.
Watermark 'WILSOTECH AGRO-ALLIED' appears on all photos.
The engine has a yellow warning/spec sticker on top, but text is unreadable.
The machine appears to be in a workshop or yard environment.

claims.claim: crushing of grains for all livestock
claims.evidence: The machine is a hammer mill, which is designed for this purpose.
While hammer mills can process various materials, the specific screens or attachments for other functions are not shown.
